scope: Offline metadata retrieval over the nine checked-in built-in Skills; labels come from their descriptions and when-to-use/when-not-to-use instructions. No model calls or Skill code execution.

positiveCases.query: 把已完成的 R 分析整理成交付脚本和说明，交给合作者复跑
positiveCases.basis: analysis-delivery: completed analysis, scripts and handoff to collaborators

positiveCases.query: 我想做土壤微生物研究，需要完整分析路线和真实案例
positiveCases.basis: analyze-like-case: comprehensive analysis route and real cases

positiveCases.query: 拿到一份没见过的生态 CSV 数据集，请先看有哪些坑
positiveCases.basis: dataset-first-look: first inspection of unfamiliar ecological tabular data

positiveCases.query: 我带来一张文献截图，这种图我也想画，请找到怎么画的案例
positiveCases.basis: figure-like-this: reproduce the type of figure from a paper screenshot

positiveCases.query: 精读多篇论文，比较实验设计和样本量并整理证据矩阵
读取 xlsx 工作簿并编辑 docx 文档
positiveCases.basis: office-docs: read and edit Office documents

positiveCases.query: 写论文分析代码时固定随机种子、集中参数并记录版本，保证可复现
positiveCases.basis: reproducible-analysis: code parameters, seeds and version records

positiveCases.query: 做一次科研审查，核对统计方法、实验单位和样本量
positiveCases.basis: scientific-review: statistical design, units and sample-size review

positiveCases.query: 把这套做法记下来，做成一个技能，以后都这么干

positiveCases.query: Plan a complete research workflow and find real analysis case studies
positiveCases.basis: analyze-like-case: full research route and real analysis cases, English paraphrase

positiveCases.query: Perform exploratory data analysis on this unfamiliar ecological dataset
positiveCases.basis: dataset-first-look: initial tabular data inspection; EDA synonym

positiveCases.query: Use this paper screenshot as a reference for plotting a similar figure
Write a literature review comparing the methods and evidence from these papers
positiveCases.basis: literature-review: multi-paper methods/evidence comparison, English paraphrase

positiveCases.query: Read the xlsx spreadsheet and edit the docx document
positiveCases.basis: office-docs: supported file formats and read/edit tools

positiveCases.query: Improve reproducibility of the analysis script with fixed random seeds and version records

positiveCases.query: Perform a statistical review of the experimental units and sample size

positiveCases.query: Save this workflow as a reusable skill so we can follow it next time

negativeCases.basis: Personal leisure request unrelated to research Skills
